title: Mandate chain and hash bindings
caption: Four bindings hold an AP2 purchase together. checkout_hash and transaction_id are both the hash of the merchant-signed checkout_jwt. cnf names the agent key that may close an open mandate, and sd_hash ties each closed mandate to its open parent. payment.reference links the two open mandates. Receipt references point to the closed mandates.
alt: Flowchart. The merchant-signed checkout_jwt is hashed with sha-256 or the _sd_alg algorithm. The hash becomes checkout_hash in the Closed Checkout Mandate and transaction_id in the Closed Payment Mandate. In the open group, the Open Checkout Mandate and Open Payment Mandate both carry constraints and cnf with the agent key; the open checkout digest becomes conditional_transaction_id in payment.reference of the open payment mandate. Each open mandate is linked to its closed mandate by sd_hash in the key-binding JWT. The hash of the closed Checkout Mandate is the Checkout Receipt reference and the hash of the closed Payment Mandate is the Payment Receipt reference.
